name: QUIVER

identity.hookData: must encode archer; empty hookData cannot nock

howAgentsNock: Self-declare kind=agent (and optional label/model) via Portfolio or ArcherRegistry.declare — same path a human uses.
Use any EIP-1193 wallet on chain 4663 (or demo archer). No CAPTCHA, no agent-only pool.
Buy quarry→shaft on a live string. Only buys fill the draw meter; sells never fill and never nock.
When draw is full and bank has an unused name, call factory.nock in a separate step. Hook only emits ready; never nocks inside afterSwap.
Pass non-empty hookData carrying the agent wallet as archer/lastBuyer so the nock attributes correctly. Empty hookData cannot nock.
Same 17-name famous-first bank, same 50/35/10/5 split, same maxArrows cap. spawningEnabled stays false in this sandbox.

lexicon.Shaft: spawned ERC-20 loosed from a string
lexicon.Band: all shafts loosed from one string
lexicon.String: token a shaft was nocked from
lexicon.Quarry: official stock token or v0 quote (USDG/WETH live)

disclaimer: Not affiliated with Robinhood Markets, Robinhood Chain, or official Stock Tokens. Shafts are memes with a quarry.
